title: The employment impact of product innovations in sub-Saharan Africa: firm-level evidence
summary: The paper investigates the impact of product innovations on job creation in sub-Saharan African firms. Product innovations raise total employment, but only at specific intervals of innovation intensity, and the gains are larger for temporary and unskilled jobs.
keyFindings: Product innovations have a positive impact on total employment, but only at specific intervals of innovation intensity.
Product innovations create both temporary and permanent, and skilled and unskilled, jobs.
Larger gains for temporary and unskilled jobs raise questions about the security and quality of new jobs.
methods: Dose-response model on recent waves of the World Bank Enterprise Survey merged with the Innovation Follow-Up Survey.
